entries.ef3b326cde37805e: The company takes 'Bringing happiness to people through the information revolution' as its management philosophy and, as a strategic investment holding company, aims to maximize NAV (the value of held shares less adjusted net interest-bearing debt) over the medium to long term by increasing the value of its held shares. Stating that the center of the information revolution has now shifted to AI, it sets as its mission the realization of artificial superintelligence (ASI) for the evolution of humankind, and conducts investment and business activities in the areas of AI models, AI chips, AI infrastructure (AI data centers and the power they require), and physical AI. The group is run under a 'group strategy', in which each company makes decisions autonomously and the group seeks synergies through capital ties and bonds among like-minded partners; it does not insist on majority ownership and does not seek unified branding. The three key priorities are: 'proactive investment to accelerate the evolution of AI and value enhancement of existing investees', 'maintaining financial discipline', and 'promoting sustainability'. As its financial policy, the company manages the LTV of SoftBank Group Corp. below 25% in normal financial market conditions and caps it at 35% even in abnormal conditions, and states that it will secure on-hand liquidity at least equal to the bonds to be redeemed over the next two years.
entries.f1ffc9d3996eb55b: This business designs semiconductor IP (design information), chips and related technologies, develops and sells semiconductor chips, and sells software tools and provides related services. It is run by Arm Holdings plc, Ampere Computing Holdings LLC, Graphcore Limited and others. Following the completion of the acquisition of Ampere in the three months ended December 31, 2025, this newly established reportable segment combines Arm, which was in the former 'Arm Business', Graphcore Limited and others, which were in 'Others', and Ampere. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥640,309 million (¥590,301 million in the previous year, restated), the second largest of the four reportable segments. Number of employees is 11,439 (as of March 31, 2026; temporary employees are separately 206).

entries.f8e05aa1bd422fdc: It is Arm Holdings plc, a semiconductor design company in Cambridge, UK. Arm's technology is used in diverse products such as smartphones, data center servers, IoT and automobiles, and it provides compute platforms that combine high performance with power efficiency. It has three business units: 'Edge AI', 'Cloud AI' and 'Physical AI'; revenue in US dollar terms for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 9.5% from the previous year on higher royalty income. In March 2026, it announced the Arm AGI CPU, its first in-house designed silicon chip since its founding. The company's voting rights ownership ratio is 86.7% (as of March 31, 2026).
